SELECT r.id AS id, r.booking_id AS bookingId, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.user_id AS userId,
u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone,
v.venue_name AS venueName, c.name AS courtName, c.type AS courtType,
r.refund_amount AS refundAmount, r.reason AS reason, r.status AS status, r.audit_user_id AS auditUserId, r.audit_remark AS auditRemark, r.audit_time AS auditTime, r.create_time AS createTime FROM booking_refund_request r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN court_booking cb ON r.booking_id = cb.id LEFT JOIN court c ON cb.court_id = c.id LEFT JOIN venue v ON c.venue_id = v.id WHERE r.is_deleted = 0
AND r.status = #{status}
AND ( r.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
